title: Apples for the Winter

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Hello again, friend! Thank you for coming all this way.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Winter is coming. We need to keep apples in the cellar, so there's fruit for everyone until spring. Five in each crate, please.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Put five apples in each crate. Count as you go: one, two, three, four, five.
steps.hint: Find a crate with an empty dip, and put an apple there.

older.prompt: Ten apples in each crate: three crates. No dips to help, so count carefully.

feedback.full: That crate is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Four crates of five: twenty apples, safe for the winter!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Twenty apples, ready for the cold months. When the snow comes, we'll still have apple pie!

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Will you come back tomorrow? There's more to do before the frost.

journal_line: I packed apples into crates for the winter with Mrs. Hannah.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Three crates of ten: thirty apples! Counting in tens makes big numbers easy.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Will you come back tomorrow? There's more to do before the frost.

older.journal_line: I packed thirty apples, ten in each crate, for the winter.
